Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis labelled Uddhav Thackeray and Raj Thackeray "Ghajinis" — a reference to the film character with short-term memory loss — in response to their joint protest march in Mumbai on Saturday.

The Thackeray cousins led the "Grand Roar March" demanding the resignation of Gyanesh Kumar, even as former chief minister Prithviraj Chavan rejected Raj Thackeray's call for an election boycott linked to the ongoing SIR row.
